title: Replace an estimate in one transaction
heading: A Change and Its Audit Entry Commit Together, or Not at All
cases: a saved estimate has its header and its three lines in the database
a revised estimate leaves one header and only the new lines, none of the old ones
a revision with a negative line is refused and the old estimate stays whole
a project name with an apostrophe is stored exactly as written
a second connection to the same file sees the saved estimate
